description.value:
Choose one damage type when you take this feat: acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or necrotic. Powers you cast ignore resistance to damage of that type, and whenever you roll damage of that type for a power, you can treat a result of 1 on any damage die as a 2.

You can take this feat more than once, choosing a different damage type each time.

system.requirements: 4th level, ability to cast force or tech powers.
